FETCHED 2026-09-06 — https://www.stadolphedhoward.qc.ca/27/patrimoine
Municipalité de Saint-Adolphe-d'Howard, "Patrimoine" page.

NOT A FULL CAPTURE. Fetched through WebFetch, which converts the page and answers a prompt
against it; the passage below is what came back, and the rest of the page has not been read.

THE PASSAGE, as returned:

    "le Y.M.C.A. s'établit sur une des îles du lac Saint-Joseph en 1893"
    (the YMCA established itself on one of the islands of Lac Saint-Joseph in 1893)

The page notes that this vacation colony no longer exists, while several historical camps in
the municipality remain active. It does NOT name Camp Jubilee or Camp Otoreke, and it does NOT
mention a dam on the lake or any change to the water level — which is what it was fetched for
(f_5160's lead, the 1923 dam Bill).

WHY THE FETCH HAPPENED. f_5162 names this page as one of four untried routes to the 1923 Bill.
It is a null for the dam and a small find for the founding date.
